meta.name: offensive-container-escape
meta.description: Container escape and breakout techniques targeting Docker, containerd, and Podman runtimes. Covers privileged container breakout via host filesystem mount and nsenter, Docker socket abuse through /var/run/docker.sock, Linux capability exploitation including CAP_SYS_ADMIN, CAP_SYS_PTRACE, and CAP_NET_ADMIN, cgroup v1 notify_on_release escape, runc CVEs such as CVE-2019-5736 and CVE-2024-21626 Leaky Vessels, kernel exploits from within containers, and Dockerfile misconfigurations like --privileged and host namespace sharing. Includes enumeration with capsh, amicontained, deepce, CDK, and nsenter. Maps to MITRE ATT&CK T1611 Escape to Host. Use this skill when the engagement scope includes container breakout, Docker escape, container privilege escalation, host access from container, or when you land inside a containerized environment and need to reach the underlying host.

howto.what: 当用户说明自己在容器(一种虚拟隔离环境)里、想逃到宿主机时,Claude会先扫描容器弱点(如特权模式、开放Docker接口、危险权限),再按步骤执行逃逸,并验证是否拿到宿主机访问权。
howto.when: 当任务涉及容器逃逸、Docker逃逸、容器提权等场景,或用户已进入容器环境需要访问宿主机时触发。

say.text: 我这个容器是特权模式,能帮我逃到宿主机吗?
容器里挂了Docker.sock,我该怎么利用它访问宿主机?

howto.what_en: When a user asks to break out of a container to the host, Claude scans for weak points (privileged mode, exposed Docker socket, dangerous capabilities), runs matching escape steps, and verifies host access.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the task involves container escape, Docker escape, container privilege escalation, or when the user has landed inside a containerized environment and needs host access.

say_en.text: My container is privileged; can you help me escape to the host?
say_en.note: Claude will guide host filesystem mounting or nsenter.

say_en.text: The Docker socket is mounted inside; how do I use it to access the host?
say_en.note: Claude shows API steps to mount host root and read files.

say_en.text: Check my container's Linux capabilities and see if I can escalate to the host.
say_en.note: Claude decodes caps with capsh and suggests escape paths.
